newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila o/night rates cut by two points-traders.
newsitem.headline: Manila o/night rates cut by two points-traders.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank had cut its overnight borrowing and lending rates by two percentage points each, traders said on Thursday.
On Wednesday, the Bank lowered one-day reverse repos and repos by the same amount, effectively cutting Thursday's overnight rates.
The overnight borrowing rate is currently at 16.0 percent from 18.0 percent, while the overnight lending rate at 18.0 percent from 20.0 percent.
